To renew a permanent resident card, users should: 1) complete Form I-90 (Application to Replace Permanent Resident Card) at least 6 months before expiration, 2) submit original documents including passport, birth certificate, and current green card, 3) provide updated photos meeting USCIS standards, 4) pay the required filing fee, 5) attend biometrics appointment, and 6) attend renewal interview at local USCIS office.

For international travel as a permanent resident, bring: 1) valid green card (permanent resident card), 2) valid passport from your country of citizenship, 3) entry/exit documents for destination country, 4) proof of residence if re-entering the US, and 5) travel documents like boarding passes. Ensure your green card is valid for the duration of your trip.
